behavior: History records sent and failed emails and the reminder and repeat settings, with who caused each
acceptance: The worker writes one history row when it sends Send to client, a reminder (with its step) or the receipt, and a failed row when it gives up; By is the owner for Send to client and Forwend otherwise
Reminders on and off write one owner row only when the setting changes; the client's stop link writes one payer row once; Stop repeating writes one owner row once; each in the change's transaction
The owner's reads return each row's step; History shows the new kinds with labels, categories (emails, changes) and the step as details
openapi.yaml, api.md, R-126 and DESIGN.md match; unit, lint and typecheck pass
notes: 2026-10-23 review fail by reviewer: apps/backend/internal/invoice/reminders.go:59-60: SetReminders reads enabled FOR UPDATE, but on an invoice with no invoice_reminders row nothing is locked, so two first toggles race. Repro: A turns on (uncommitted), B turns off and waits on the insert; result is enabled=false with history only 'reminders.on' (two on calls write two rows). Lock the invoice row first as payer_email.go:36 does (SELECT id FROM invoices WHERE id = $1 AND profile_id = $2 FOR UPDATE). Rest is correct: deliverOne writes only on send and give-up in its tx, skip/retry/owner/welcome/job paths write nothing, StopReminders/StopRetainer write once with unchanged answers, contracts agree, tests pass.

2026-10-23 review pass by reviewer: Re-review after fixes: SetReminders now locks the invoice FOR NO KEY UPDATE before reading enabled, so first toggles take turns and the stop link's history FK (KEY SHARE) can't deadlock with it; the regression test covers it. Email rows are written only on send and give-up in the delivery transaction (retry, skip and non-client kinds write nothing, now tested), stops write once, contracts and web agree; notify, invoice, history, httpapi tests (-race), tsc, vitest and docs-check pass.
